headline: Contested Sectors Keep the Front in Motion
war_summary: The latest returns show the war’s decisive movement still confined to a narrow belt of contested sectors, with several fronts cooling after earlier action. Weathered Expanse remains the busiest ledger at 36 base events in 24 hours, though none were recorded in the latest two-hour window; its nine holdings stand seven Colonial to two Warden. Stlican Shelf has 27 events, three in six hours, and is divided six Colonial, two Warden, with one base neutral. Palantine Berm reports 19 events, including five in the latest two hours, amid a five-Warden, one-Colonial, one-neutral split. Callahan’s Passage has continued its sharp exchange, recording three events in two hours and 13 across the day; nine bases are Warden-held and one Colonial. Kuura Strand posts 14 events, three recently, while all six bases remain Warden-held. Nevish Line’s 17 events mark another unsettled front, though its latest two-hour return is quiet; five bases are Warden and three Colonial. Elsewhere, ownership ledgers are largely still, and no victor is declared.
